Package com.stripe.model.v2.moneymanagement

Class PayoutIntent

java.lang.Object
com.stripe.model.StripeObject
com.stripe.model.v2.moneymanagement.PayoutIntent
All Implemented Interfaces:
HasId, StripeObjectInterface
public class PayoutIntent extends StripeObject implements HasId
PayoutIntent represents an intent to send funds from a Financial Account to a payout method.

    • getConfirmationMethod

      public String getConfirmationMethod()
      Controls whether the PayoutIntent requires explicit confirmation before transitioning to pending. Even when automatic, regulatory requirements may require confirmation. See Send money with Global Payouts for details.

      One of automatic, or manual.

    • getCreated

      Time at which the PayoutIntent was created. Represented as a RFC 3339 date & time UTC value in millisecond precision, for example: 2022-09-18T13:22:18.123Z.
